chunks.name: artifact_identity
chunks.doc: 🗿️ Artifact identity: the artifact state record and its conversions, the schema id, the dialect coordinate and the two artifact kinds.

chunks.name: precompute_catalogs
chunks.doc: 🧱️ Precompute catalogs: the host rules and weights, the kind catalogs, the scene wire projection and the object, vortex and attraction props the precompute session exchanges with its host.

chunks.name: precompute_commands
chunks.doc: 🎬️ Precompute commands: the brush and fill readouts, the run stage, counter and reason vocabularies, the typed command envelope and the session errors.

chunks.name: document_model
chunks.doc: 📚️ Document model: the scale, the objects, vortices, attractions, target volumes, references, the kind catalogs and the document meta of the puzzle 3d artifact.

chunks.name: pose_math
chunks.doc: 📐️ Pose math: the vector and quaternion helpers, the vortex full id and the attraction pose derivation.
